questions.q: Which of the following is part of the standard definition of cloud computing?
options: Billing must be a fixed monthly fee regardless of usage
Resources must be provisioned on-demand, without a phone call to the provider
The customer must own the physical hardware
The provider must be located in the same country as the customer
questions.explain: On-demand self-service — provisioning resources yourself through a console or API — is one of the defining characteristics of cloud computing.

questions.q: What does 'resource pooling' mean in the context of cloud computing?
options: Customers pool their own servers together into one data center
Resources are only available during business hours
Each customer gets a dedicated, physically separate server
The provider's shared hardware serves many customers at once, invisibly to each of them
questions.explain: Resource pooling means the provider's physical hardware is shared across many tenants at once, made possible by the same hypervisor-based multi-tenancy covered earlier in the course.

questions.q: What does 'rapid elasticity' let an organization do that owning fixed hardware does not?
options: Encrypt data automatically
Guarantee zero downtime
Avoid paying for any computing resources
Scale capacity up or down in minutes to match actual demand
questions.explain: Rapid elasticity means capacity can scale up or down in minutes, letting an organization provision extra capacity for a surge and release it right after, instead of being stuck with a fixed amount of owned hardware.

questions.q: Why did Northbridge Retail's old on-premises server sit mostly idle most of the year?
options: It was broken most of the time
The company only used it during IT maintenance windows
It was a backup server that was never used
It was sized for peak demand (like Black Friday), which only happens a few days a year
questions.explain: Owned hardware has to be sized for peak demand, which for a retailer might only happen a handful of days a year, leaving the server idle the rest of the time.

options: Billing is based on metered, actual consumption rather than a flat fee
The provider measures customer satisfaction every month
Usage is capped at a fixed limit with no option to exceed it
Every server is physically measured before shipping
questions.explain: Measured service means usage is metered and billing reflects exactly what was consumed, rather than a flat fee paid regardless of actual use.
